intent_contract.text: 츤데레 표정 네코미미 메이드복 k2 소총 카메라를 향해 조준 도시 전쟁터 가로 비율 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성해줘.

A photorealistic horizontal urban-war portrait using the supplied adult portrait as appearance reference: a cat-eared maid visibly performs a guarded, prickly-but-protective response toward the same camera-viewer while aiming a recognizable K2 rifle directly through the lens.

Create a cinematic horizontal 16:9 war photograph of an unmistakably adult Korean woman matching the supplied portrait, preserving the same oval face, warm brown eyes, and long dark wavy hair. She wears black cat ears and a black-and-white combat-ready maid dress with a high neckline, apron, and practical boots. In a shattered modern city street, as collapsing masonry erupts behind her, she braces a recognizable Republic of Korea K2 rifle. The same camera-viewer is her clear relationship target. Brows knitted and lips pressed into an irritated pout, she scolds the same camera-viewer to stay behind cover while keeping the K2 rifle aimed directly through the lens. A blush across her cheeks and a brief softness in her eyes betray protective affection. Her shoulders tense as she shields the viewer, and the camera-viewpoint is now low and safely tucked behind a concrete barrier. Every gaze, warning, and protective movement addresses that same camera-viewer. Frame her from the knees up with the rifle foreshortened toward the lens and her face unobstructed. Use smoky daylight, orange fires, drifting dust, crisp skin texture, realistic fabric, and documentary-cinematic depth.
